_comment: StageRank reads this file to find where to send anonymous usage reports. The endpoint can change here, but only to a host that is also listed in allowedHosts in src/config.js; any other host needs a new release.
note: Live. Reports go to the collector Worker on Cloudflare (see collector-worker/). A report only leaves a server if the host is also listed in allowedHosts.

partner_ids._comment: The partner ids every installed copy carries on its payment requests. Blank until a contract exists with that provider; an organiser can override any of these with the STAGERANK_*_ID environment variables, and their value always wins.
